name: 365 Days in an Asylum
source:
"In our world, no one is normal. Normalcy does not exist. People always say and think others are more normal than themselves, but in reality, everyone is different. And unfortunately, some are different but...in the wrong way. If we can say them like that.. Society calls them 'the mentally ill'. And I'm one of them."

Samuel was supposed to be admitted to a mental hospital because of his disease phobia, but when he arrived at his destination, he suddenly woke up in an... asylum?

[Translated from [url=https://unenekowolfy.itch.io/365-asylum]Itch.io[/url]]
